propertyPriceZero: Property price must be greater than zero.
downPaymentBelowMin: Down payment below Canadian minimum ({{minPct}} ≈ {{minDp}}). CMHC will not insure this loan as-is.
propertyNotInsurable: Properties above $1.5M are not insurable. CMHC premium is zero; lender will require ≥ 20% down.
amortizationCmhcSurcharge: Amortization > 25y on an insured mortgage adds a 0.20% CMHC surcharge.
zeroMortgageRate: Mortgage rate is 0%; payment is principal / amortization months.
horizonExceedsAmortization: Time horizon ({{years}}y) exceeds amortization ({{amort}}y). After the mortgage is paid off, owning cost drops to property expenses only (no P&I).
